license_reference: MIT repository LICENSE at pinned commit; preserve attribution; verify data-specific notices
body_inspection_before_split: first 128 physical CSV data records are a declared development schema probe; all later records remain quarantined, not a certified final population
taint_policy: Any component connected by subject/session/device or identical content/template to an observed development probe belongs to development. Do not promote it to final evaluation.
split_status: not yet certified; inspect only file/schema metadata and development probe before defining source-specific group/split procedure
label_contract: Only explicit publisher boolean Suspicious values are candidate truth; missing/nonboolean values are unknown. Audit generation meaning and consistency before treating this as independent security truth.
missing_claims: Never manufacture managed/healthy posture, MFA, identity-active state, resource-owner role policy or business approval. A historical data field is not current authenticated authority.
file_handling: Pinned whole hashes; bounded listing and one named regular CSV streamed to an opaque path; no code or macro execution, no arbitrary archive extraction.
source_scope: publisher isolated cyber-range bot and attack traffic, not actual enterprise operations
